html:
It’s important to rely on the best reference books during your CBSE 9 th and 10 th so that you are prepared in a well-rounded and thorough way. With so many options, it can be hard to identify which reference books are the most ideal. Here is a list of few of our top favourites:

Reference books for class 9 th :
At this stage, it’s important to start preparing a strong understanding of foundational concepts. This will serve you well as you advance academically. Any basic doubts should be cleared at this stage so you can enter 10 th grade and attempt competitive exams confidently. These are the best reference books for 9 th grade students:

> RD Sharma Solutions for Class 9 students
> Lakhmir Singh Solutions for Class 9 students
> RS Aggarwal Solutions for Class 9 students

Reference books for class 10 th :
In 10 th , you need reference books that prepare you for your boards as well as help you develop a deep topical understanding for future competitive exams. This is a crucial year for all students, hence it’s necessary to rely on trusted reference books. Here are our top picks:

> Mathematics for Class 10 – R D Sharma
> Secondary School Mathematics for Class 10 – RS Aggarwal
> Physics by Lakhmir Singh and Manjit Kaur
> Principles of Physics by S Chand
> Biology by N.K Chowdhry
> Chemistry by Lakhmir Singh and Manjit Kaur

Make these books a regular part of your preparation and you can ace the exams with ease. Focus on regular studies and develop a thorough understanding of the syllabus. With the right attitude and tools, you too can be a topper!
